async function obtainTwelveCoal(bot) {
    // This function checks if the required amount of coal has been collected; if not, it ensures the bot has an appropriate pickaxe. It then attempts to mine nearby coal or deepslate coal ore blocks. If the initial search fails to yield enough coal, it performs two short exploratory searches in different directions. If these searches also fail to reach the target of twelve coal, it throws an error indicating the local search was exhausted.
